text_block_list.text:
Summer is coming to an end... The Senior 
Class summer spent running alongside 
Matikane Fukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Man, we gave it everything we had, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
From the summer training camp to regional 
tours, I've been soaking up the energy of 
Mother Nature all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, gods really do 
exist. In each and every land.”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's hard to put into words, but 
there are gods in the mountains, the sea, 
and the towns too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Connecting with that somehow feels like it 
replenishes my energy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe it isn't just gods. Humans might 
be the same way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
People are everywhere, and by building 
trust with strangers, our spirits rise.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I realized that's what faith... what 
believing is all about.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I think I just said something really 
great! Something really 
profound-sounding!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand, but either way, 
let's head back! The Arima Kinen is 
waiting for us!
